title: MWPO: Enhancing LLMs Performance through Multi-Weight Preference Strength and Length Optimization
authors_zh: Shiyue Xu、Fu Zhang、Jingwei Cheng、Linfeng Zhou（东北大学）
paper_type_zh: 偏好数据加权与优化目标研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计离线偏好优化、且需要同时应对弱偏好标签与长度偏差的读者。
one_line: MWPO weights each DPO preference pair by its implicit reward margin and response-length margin to improve alignment while counteracting verbosity.
MWPO 依据隐式奖励差距与回答长度差距为每个 DPO 偏好回答对赋权，以提升对齐表现并抑制冗长输出。
why: It makes preference strength and length bias explicit record-level training signals rather than treating all chosen-rejected pairs equally.
inclusion_reason: It changes how every offline preference pair is consumed by combining model-relative preference confidence and response-length bias into the DPO loss weight.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Offline DPO normally gives every chosen-rejected pair the same formal role. When two responses are close in quality, however, their label can be weak or noisy; the training loss can still push hard on it. A second distortion comes from preference corpora in which chosen answers are often longer, allowing optimization to reward verbosity rather than better task completion.

MWPO asks whether the weight of an existing preference pair should reflect both how confidently the current policy separates its responses and how much their lengths favor verbosity. It does not collect a new corpus or ask for extra annotators. Instead, it changes the decision by which an offline record influences a DPO update.

离线 DPO 通常让每条优选—劣选回答对在形式上承担相同作用。然而，当两个回答质量接近时，它们之间的偏好标签可能很弱或带有噪声，训练损失仍可能对其施加强烈更新。第二种扭曲来自偏好语料中优选回答常常更长的现象，它会让优化奖励冗长，而非更好的任务完成。

MWPO 询问，一条既有偏好回答对的权重是否应同时反映当前策略区分两个回答的置信程度，以及它们的长度差距是否有利于冗长输出。它既不收集新语料，也不要求额外标注者，而是改变一条离线记录影响 DPO 更新的决策方式。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MWPO derives a reward-margin weight from the current policy's implicit DPO rewards: a pair receives a larger signal when the chosen response is already assigned a stronger reward than the rejected response. This is intended to favor records whose preference direction is more reliable to the evolving policy, while reducing the effect of pairs with an apparently contradictory or weak direction.

It also derives a length-controlled weight from the chosen-minus-rejected token-length margin. A pair whose chosen answer is much longer receives less influence. The two weights are fused with a geometric mixture and multiply the ordinary DPO loss, so quality confidence and anti-verbosity pressure must jointly support a high-impact update.

MWPO 从当前策略的隐式 DPO 奖励中导出奖励差距权重：当模型已经为优选回答分配了高于劣选回答的奖励时，该回答对获得更大的信号。其目的在于偏向对不断变化的策略而言偏好方向更可靠的记录，同时减弱那些看似矛盾或方向较弱的回答对的影响。

它还从优选回答减去劣选回答的词元长度差距中导出长度控制权重。优选回答明显更长的回答对会获得更小影响。两个权重通过几何混合结合并乘到普通 DPO 损失上，因此质量置信与抑制冗长的压力必须共同支持一次高影响更新。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each instruction and preference pair, the method computes chosen and rejected implicit rewards from policy-to-reference log-probability ratios. Their sigmoid margin yields the reward weight. It computes a second sigmoid from the scaled difference between rejected and chosen token counts; this decreases the weight when the preferred response is longer. A mixing coefficient combines the two signals geometrically, and the resulting value scales the DPO loss without back-propagating through the weight.

The paper trains full parameters of Mistral-7B-Base, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base, Llama-3.2-3B-Base, and Llama-3-8B-Instruct. Base models are first instruction-tuned with UltraChat-200k and then optimized on UltraFeedback-binarized; instruction-tuned models use PairRM-labeled Princeton Llama3 UltraFeedback pairs. It compares DPO, RRHF, IPO, KTO, CPO, R-DPO, SimPO, and WPO on AlpacaEval 2 and five downstream benchmarks.

对于每条指令和偏好回答对，该方法从策略相对参考模型的对数概率比计算优选与劣选回答的隐式奖励。它们差距的 sigmoid 值形成奖励权重。它再从劣选与优选回答词元数的缩放差值计算第二个 sigmoid；当优选回答更长时，该权重会降低。混合系数以几何方式结合两种信号，所得数值缩放 DPO 损失，而权重本身不参与反向传播。

论文训练了 Mistral-7B-Base、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base、Llama-3.2-3B-Base 与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的全参数。基础模型先用 UltraChat-200k 做指令微调，再在 UltraFeedback-binarized 上优化；指令模型使用由 PairRM 标注的 Princeton Llama3 UltraFeedback 回答对。它在 AlpacaEval 2 和五个下游基准上比较 DPO、RRHF、IPO、KTO、CPO、R-DPO、SimPO 与 WPO。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
In the Mistral-7B-Base setting, MWPO reports a 23.8% length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2, versus 15.1% for DPO, while average output length falls from 1,719 to 1,557 tokens. It also exceeds the reported SimPO and WPO length-controlled win rates of 20.8% and 23.5%. Across GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, TruthfulQA, MMLU, and GPQA, its average exact-match score is 46.16, compared with 44.90 for DPO.

The ablations identify a real trade-off rather than a single free gain. Reward-margin weighting alone improves the reported length-controlled win rate but makes answers longer; length weighting alone shortens answers by more than 20% relative to DPO under the shown settings, but excessive control removes needed content. The mixed objective is the evidence that the two record-level signals can balance each other in the reported setup.

在 Mistral-7B-Base 设置中，MWPO 在 AlpacaEval 2 上报告了 23.8% 的长度控制胜率，而 DPO 为 15.1%；平均输出长度则从 1,719 个词元降至 1,557 个。它也超过了报告中 SimPO 的 20.8% 和 WPO 的 23.5% 长度控制胜率。在 GSM8K、ARC-Challenge、TruthfulQA、MMLU 与 GPQA 上，它的平均精确匹配分数为 46.16，而 DPO 为 44.90。

消融实验表明这是真实的权衡，而非单一的免费收益。单独使用奖励差距加权会提升报告的长度控制胜率，却让回答变长；在展示的设置下，单独使用长度加权能使回答比 DPO 缩短超过 20%，但过强控制会移除必要内容。混合目标提供的证据是，这两种记录级信号能在论文报告的设置中相互平衡。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier DPO variants either treat offline pairs uniformly, add a length term directly to the reward, or weight pairs for a different purpose such as on-policy resemblance. MWPO makes two properties of the same stored record explicit optimization inputs: the model-relative confidence in its preference direction and the chosen-versus-rejected length margin. It therefore changes the training consumer without changing the label source.

The important design choice is geometric fusion rather than two independent penalties. A high update weight requires both a favorable preference signal and a favorable length signal, and the mixing coefficient exposes their trade-off. This gives the record a reusable audit question: whether its measured reward margin is meaningful rather than merely correlated with response length.

较早的 DPO 变体要么统一对待离线回答对，要么直接向奖励加入长度项，要么为接近在策略数据等不同目的对回答对加权。MWPO 把同一存储记录的两项属性变成显式优化输入：模型相对其偏好方向的置信度，以及优选与劣选回答的长度差距。因此，它在不改变标签来源的情况下改变了训练消费者。

关键设计选择是几何融合，而不是两项彼此独立的惩罚。一次高权重更新必须同时拥有有利的偏好信号和有利的长度信号，混合系数公开了二者的权衡。这为记录提供了可复用的审计问题：其测得的奖励差距是否有意义，而不只是与回答长度相关。

title: Limitations
局限
html: MWPO assumes that a policy's current implicit reward margin is a useful proxy for preference reliability, yet that margin can itself inherit model bias and length effects. The paper reports that reward and length margins are correlated in its setting, and it fixes the length scale while searching only a small set of mixture coefficients. Its strongest alignment evidence also uses LLM judging or a proxy evaluator, so independent human evaluation and broader data-quality audits remain necessary before treating its weights as ground truth.
MWPO 假定策略当前的隐式奖励差距是偏好可靠性的有用代理，但该差距本身可能继承模型偏差和长度效应。论文报告，在其设置中奖励差距与长度差距相关，并且固定了长度缩放系数，只搜索了少量混合系数。其最强的对齐证据也使用大模型评判或代理评估器，因此，在把这些权重当作真值之前，仍需要独立人工评估和更广泛的数据质量审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use MWPO when an offline preference corpus is retained but its pairs differ in separation strength and show an unwanted chosen-longer pattern. It is practical for teams that can compute policy and reference log probabilities but cannot obtain new labels. Before adoption, inspect the joint distribution of length and implicit margins, sweep the mixture and length controls on the target task, and verify that shorter output is not suppressing required reasoning or safety detail.
当离线偏好语料需要保留，但其中回答对的区分强度不同且存在不希望出现的“优选更长”模式时，可以使用 MWPO。它适合能计算策略与参考模型对数概率、却无法获得新标签的团队。采用前应检查长度与隐式差距的联合分布，在目标任务上扫描混合与长度控制，并验证较短输出没有压制必要的推理或安全细节。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the gradient discussion together with the ablations: the reward margin does not simply select easy examples, but alters the DPO gradient after the ordinary contrastive term. Then compare the absolute AlpacaEval length and length-controlled win rate, not only the relative improvement. The reusable takeaway is to log the pair's label, current implicit margin, and length margin separately; a single reward score cannot reveal whether the update is driven by preference evidence or a verbosity shortcut.
应把梯度讨论与消融实验一起阅读：奖励差距并非只是选择容易示例，而是在普通对比项之后改变 DPO 梯度。随后比较 AlpacaEval 的绝对输出长度与长度控制胜率，而不只看相对提升。可复用的结论是，应分别记录回答对的标签、当前隐式差距与长度差距；单一奖励分数无法揭示更新究竟由偏好证据还是由冗长捷径驱动。
